info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Creditcard Applications Creditchecks-v4-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Overview API allows users to access a detailed list of credit card applications and their associated credit check statuses. This endpoint provides insights into the processing of applications, enabling financial institutions and service providers to monitor and evaluate credit assessments efficiently. Typical consumers include credit analysts, loan officers, and financial product managers looking to streamline application processes and ensure timely decision-making. This API facilitates improved operational transparency and helps enhance customer service outcomes.

get.summary: Retrieve credit check information for applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the credit check details for specific applications. It provides essential information necessary for making informed decisions related to credit assessments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a credit check query for an application. It should contain all necessary details required to perform the credit check, ensuring that the information complies with the expected schema.

200.description: Credit check request completed successfully, returning the results in the response body.

ListCreditcardApplicationsCreditchecksRe.title: Credit Check Request Body
